ValidationRule.description: Agent closed case as "No defect" but a defect has been found and rectified before.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = "KYC_QA", ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "No Defect"), OR( KYCChecksHasDefect__c, ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c, "Yes") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The KYC check for this case is already completed with a defect, you cannot select No Defect.
